boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-admission activities and spaces for Montclair State students, with public access noted where applicable.

cards.title: Browse the George Segal Gallery
cards.subtitle: Red Hawk Parking Deck, fourth floor
cards.notes: Meet at the gallery’s fourth-floor space and look through the current exhibition together; use the adjacent outside corridor for access.
cards.short_summary: A public campus gallery visit with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State identifies the George Segal Gallery as its flagship exhibition space and states University Galleries admission is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; the gallery is on the fourth floor of Red Hawk Parking Deck. Parking may cost extra.

cards.title: See the Kasser Theater display cases
cards.subtitle: Alexander Kasser Theater lobby
cards.notes: Stop by the ground and mezzanine-level cases during the academic year, then compare which displayed work catches each person’s eye.
cards.short_summary: A free look at rotating gallery displays in the theater lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Galleries page says exhibitions are displayed in the Alexander Kasser Theater lobby during fall and spring, and that gallery admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Free gallery admission; displays are on view during fall and spring semesters. Check current exhibition hours before going.

cards.title: Take a sculpture walk
cards.subtitle: Public art installed throughout campus
cards.notes: Use the gallery’s outdoor-sculpture listings as a loose route, pausing at each artwork to take photos and compare materials or viewpoints.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor art walk that remains available when indoor shows are between terms.
cards.evidence_claim: University Galleries maintains public art throughout campus and says summer visitors can explore outdoor sculptures; University Galleries admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor sculptures are available to summer visitors; gallery admission is free. Stay on public campus walkways.

cards.title: Tour an exhibition virtually
cards.subtitle: Online from University Galleries
cards.notes: Open a virtual walkthrough on a phone or laptop, pick one exhibition, and trade observations as you move through the digital rooms together.
cards.short_summary: A location-flexible gallery hang with no trip or admission needed.
cards.evidence_claim: University Galleries offers virtual tours of past and current exhibitions through Matterport walkthroughs viewable on desktop, mobile, or VR.
cards.access_notes: The official virtual walkthroughs are viewable on desktop or mobile; no admission or purchase is required.

cards.title: Walk the self-guided campus route
cards.subtitle: Montclair campus
cards.notes: Download the official self-guided map, choose a few stops rather than rushing all of them, and use it to orient a visiting friend.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced campus walk using the university’s downloadable map.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State invites visitors to download its Self-Guided Tour Map and discover campus at their own pace.
cards.source_title: Visit and Tour | Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: The self-guided map is downloadable and self-paced. Do not assume visitor parking is free.

cards.entity_name: Montclair State University Virtual Campus Tour
cards.title: Compare campus stops on the virtual tour
cards.subtitle: Online campus experience
cards.notes: Pull up the official virtual tour with a friend, then use the interactive map to compare residence halls, classrooms, and campus landmarks.
cards.short_summary: A free online way to explore campus together from anywhere.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State offers a virtual campus tour and directs visitors to its Video Viewbook and Interactive Campus Map.
cards.source_title: Visit and Tour | Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Available online through the university’s virtual-tour link; no admission or purchase is required.

cards.title: Ride the campus shuttle loop
cards.subtitle: Campus shuttle stops across Montclair campus
cards.notes: Use the TripShot app to follow the shuttle, pick a campus stop to explore, and ride back rather than treating the walk as the only option.
cards.short_summary: A free campus transit loop for moving between academic, residential, and parking areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State’s exchange handbook says the university offers a free campus shuttle for students and that service is available to students, staff, and visitors.
cards.source_title: Montclair State University Inbound Exchange Handbook 2025–2026
cards.access_notes: Official handbook describes the shuttle as free and available campuswide; consult TripShot for live routes and service.

cards.title: Shoot around in the SRC gym
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring a valid Montclair State ID, meet at the two-court gymnasium, and check in before starting a casual basketball or open-gym session.
cards.short_summary: A student-ID-accessible gym space for a simple active hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State says Student Recreation Center admission is free with a valid student ID and lists a two-court gymnasium among its facilities.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation | Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Free for students with a valid Montclair State University ID; check facility availability before playing.

cards.title: Walk the indoor track
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use the elevated indoor track for a low-key walk-and-talk; bring your Montclair State ID and follow any posted recreation-center rules.
cards.short_summary: An indoor option for moving, talking, and avoiding bad weather.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State says Student Recreation Center admission is free with a valid student ID and lists an elevated indoor track among its facilities.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation | Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Free for students with a valid Montclair State University ID; check the recreation center’s current access rules.

cards.title: Plan a pool-session hang
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Coordinate around open-pool availability, bring your valid student ID, and use the six-lane indoor pool for a relaxed swim or lap session.
cards.short_summary: A student-accessible indoor pool for a no-purchase activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State says Student Recreation Center admission is free with a valid student ID and lists a 25-yard, six-lane heated indoor pool.
cards.source_title: Athletics and Recreation | Montclair State University
cards.access_notes: Free for students with a valid Montclair State University ID; confirm pool hours and any required swim policies first.
